jobs.e9a95577736b: unclear: fires on " the" in license boilerplate right after "published by" / "Licensed under" (GNU GPL/Apache headers); weaker on other function words in running text.
jobs.d4674c4b4800: Fires on " the"/" a"/" an" right after a preposition or verb in encyclopedic or methods prose ("member of the", "listed on the", "by an"); also digits inside exponents.
jobs.1ac260437168: Fires on LaTeX/math markup tokens such as "{" after \mathbb, "\" or ")" inside $...$ in scientific text; weaker on list separators (",", " or", " and") between disease names.
jobs.94e5bb7d689f: unclear: fires on the first token of a document or snippet (no preceding context), mostly a space-led word like " In", " no", " really", " what".
jobs.9ae077d882db: Fires on a mid-word subword fragment of a rare name or long word, after a capital letter or partial word (K|irc|he, Advance|ment, ha|irc|ut, photop|roduction).
jobs.67fbc1ae4a58: unclear: fires on syntax glue in code/LaTeX/math-quiz text, like newline after "()", " +" in polynomials, "\define", "=" or " <-" operators, and " to" in methods prose.
jobs.5e8018e0b8ab: Fires on the first word of a new line or segment: byline "By", case-caption first name, verse line starts ("And", "Of"), or a " -" after a headline title.
jobs.19f35823418d: Fires on a noun/determiner just before "of": " type", " array", " series", " grant", " evidence", " collection" ("this type of", "a series of", "a diverse array of").
jobs.c9985f5c9d37: unclear: fires on a word-start or mid-word fragment where a longer word or phrase is being spelled out (" Find" after math setup, "reve|red", " ((-" in math, " is" after a name).
jobs.a06f9bbd81b4: Fires on short word-start fragments "El", "del", "st", "t" (El Paso, Elton, Elaine, delve, stammered, stink); the token is the start of a longer word.
jobs.963652bea9f7: unclear: short word fragments in non-English text (Russian, Italian, Dutch), or " and"/"He"/"It" starting a clause after a biography's first sentence.
jobs.d3f33de3754e: Fires on a modifier or ordinal just before a noun, such as " first", " initial", " final", " opening", " usual", "External" ("the band's first", "its initial public").
jobs.b9efb7195318: Fires on the newline token right after an opening "/*", "/**" or "//" that starts a source-file comment block, esp. just after <|endoftext|>.
jobs.8c9283ae677c: Fires on a closing bracket ")" or "]" after a single letter or digit ("(B)", "[W]e", "(1)"), or " %" in a printf format string right after text.
jobs.8c3bd43ae1aa: unclear: fires on a conjunction or contrast word starting a clause (" but", " and", " some", " others") in license text and prose, plus numbers in quiz questions.
jobs.92edc8e8747c: unclear: fires on an adjective or connective just before the main noun in academic prose (" using", " good", " and", " non", " sequential"); also "pr" in Russian "не пр|огадаете".
jobs.828172cb03d6: Fires on the <|endoftext|> token that ends one document, right after the previous document's final sentence.

jobs.8570785138b6: unclear: fires on a comma or pronoun completing a verb phrase ("as we have done,", "directly or indirectly,", "brought with it"), plus mid-word pieces like "contra|ven|e".
